title: When the Horizon Burns Anew
author: Freya Eriksen
blurb: Noor Kavanagh, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
